request.text: [worried] My Queen... my brother Kesh took a patrol north-west, toward the old webs. They never came back.

text: My Queen... my brother Kesh took a patrol north-west, toward the old webs. They never came back.

voice.description: A young male scout of about eighteen: a light, bright tenor voice, quick and eager, loyal and earnest, a little breathless from running, nervous energy he tries to hide in front of his queen. He speaks English with a soft, neutral accent, close to the microphone in a quiet room, performing a character in a fantasy game.
